main.description: Accounts this AppView serves for a listed community whose handle or display name starts with q, as app.bsky.actor.searchActors answers, paged. Case and diacritics are ignored; a leading @ is dropped. Order: the exact handle, then handles starting with q, then display names starting with q, each by handle; the cursor keeps its place in that order as accounts come and go. Every view carries app.nearhorizon.refract.defs#restored. An account the moderation gate hides, one the caller blocks or is blocked by, and one the caller fully mutes is left out after the page is cut, so a page can be short and still carry a cursor. Any signed-in caller.

q.description: At most 100 characters after trimming. Empty: no actors.

servedAs.description: The form this answer was served in: `member` (a ready member, with its stored viewer state) or `visitor` (anyone else).

withheld.description: Matching accounts of this page held back for a reason that is not final: `unanswered`, a visitor's block check with the account got no answer.

errors.name: InvalidRequest
errors.description: q is longer than 100 characters, or the cursor is not one this method gave.
